description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractJmsListener that implements message listening and exception handling for JMS (Java Message Service). It handles deserialization of messages, invokes services based on message contents, and manages connection state.

classes.name: AbstractJmsListener
classes.description: An abstract class implementing JMS message listening and exception handling, providing mechanisms to run services based on message content and managing connection status.

methods.name: AbstractJmsListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dispatcher using a given delegator.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Processes a MapMessage to invoke a specified service with a deserialized context.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming JMS messages; processes MapMessages to trigger service execution.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles JMS exceptions; attempts to refresh connection until successful.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Re-establishes connection by closing and loading the listener.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the listener is currently connected to JMS.
